scheme_name: Samagra Samajik Suraksha Vridh Ashram Mai Nivaasarat Ant-vasi Pension Yojana
other_conditions: The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
The applicant must be above 60 years of age.
The applicant must reside in a recognized Vridvashram (old‑age home).
The applicant’s name must be marked on the Samagra portal.
benefits_summary: A monthly pension of ₹600 is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
